hero.heading: THE MOST HATED COMMUNITY, YET ONLY A FEW REMAINED
hero.sub:
XIV Community is a competitive and active Call of Duty: Mobile (CODM) community built for players who are serious about improving, competing, and grinding their way to the top.

We bring together dedicated CODM players who enjoy the competitive side of the game, especially Leaderboard and Weapon Rank grinding. XIV values consistency, teamwork, activity, and the determination to keep improving every season.

What XIV Stands For
▪ Competitive Spirit — We encourage members to challenge themselves and aim for higher ranks.
▪ Active Players — We value members who are consistently involved in the game and community.
▪ Leaderboard Grind — XIV is built around players who enjoy pushing ranks and weapon leaderboards.
▪ Respect & Discipline — Expect members to follow community rules.
▪ Growth & Improvement — Every season is another opportunity to improve, compete, and achieve more.

items.title: Play with a full squad every day
items.desc: Solo queue is fine. Playing with five people who communicate is better. We have enough active members that you can always find a squad for ranked or casual at Manila hours.

items.title: Compete in scrims and clan wars
items.desc: We run structured scrims twice a week and enter every clan war cycle. The war squad is selected on merit — show up consistently and perform, and you're on it.

items.title: Get better by playing with better players
items.desc: Our leadership includes Legendary-tier players who review VODs and give real feedback after scrims. If you want to improve, the tools are here.
